source_field_map.subject: Paralycopodites opposite-row compact lateral-branch lycopsid
source_field_map.factual_scope: Genus-level living reconstruction, not exact fossil individual. Lateral row position and determinate branching use DiMichele and Bateman2020 primary text. Cone and leaf dimensions are illustrative choices near described specimens, not universal fossil ranges. Anatomy pixels are Seward1910 fig186A/B under a historical name linked to Paralycopodites by DiMichele1980; they do not directly demonstrate whole architecture. Exact height, counts, colors and complete outline are artistic.
identifying_features: One columnar main trunk ending in a limited two-leader fork; ten compact lateral systems in two opposite vertical rows on the main trunk, and four continuing those rows on crown axes. Not helical or radial branch whorls.

Each of fourteen lateral systems forms four unequal terminal axes on a broadly planar anisotomous scaffold; fifty-six slender terminal strobili, small persistent narrow microphylls on twigs and trunk.
Four subdued basal rhizomorph beginnings. No flowers, fruit, spherical cones, terminal-only Lepidodendron crown, coarse diamond bark armor or invented expansive modern tree roots.

scientific_limits.en: Interpretive genus-level living plant with compact opposite-row lateral systems, small slender cones and subdued basal rhizomorph beginnings. Counts, crown outline, four basal beginnings, palette and nominal dimensions are artistic, not universal fossil facts or a specimen cast. Prior source review used relevant 2020 text/captions, not figure-pixel verification; vascular anatomy alone does not establish the external crown or roots.
scientific_limits.zh: 属级解释性生活植物复原：紧凑对列侧枝、小型细长球果及低调的基部根状体起始。数量、冠形、四处基部起始、配色和名义尺寸属美术选择，不是普遍化石事实或标本翻模。既有来源审阅依据2020年相关正文和图注，未核验图像像素；维管解剖本身不能证明外部冠形或根形。
